Where we fly you

The routes Lauderhill asks for most

We ticket every major Caribbean route out of Fort Lauderdale and Miami — and plenty beyond. Pick a destination and we'll price it for your dates; fares change daily, so the quote is always today's.

FLL / MIA → KIN · MBJ

Jamaica

Kingston for family, Montego Bay for the beach. Multiple airlines, same-day options, and fares worth calling about before Carnival and Christmas sell through.

FLL / MIA → POS

Trinidad & Tobago

Port of Spain for Carnival, family visits and business — plus the short hop over to Tobago when the trip calls for sand and quiet.

MIA / JFK → GEO

Guyana

Georgetown trips take planning — connections, baggage and timing all matter. We work the routings so you arrive when family expects you.

FLL / MIA → BGI

Barbados

Bridgetown and beyond — Crop Over trips, weddings on the west coast, and winter escapes when Florida isn't warm enough.

FLL / MIA → NAS

The Bahamas

Nassau is under an hour away — weekend trips, family-island connections and last-minute getaways priced the same day you call.

Port Everglades · Miami

Caribbean cruises

Sail from the ports in our backyard. We match cabins, decks and dining to your group — and handle the details a booking site won't.

What we do

A real agency, not a search engine

Everything E.C. World Wide Travel books, handled start to finish by a person you can call back.

Caribbean flight tickets

Our home turf. We compare every airline flying your route — nonstop and one-stop — and flag the fare rules that matter: baggage, changes, and the cheap ticket that isn't cheap once the fees land.

Vacation packages

Flights, hotel and transfers bundled into one price and one phone call. Tell us the occasion — honeymoon, reunion, milestone birthday — and we'll build the trip around it.

Cruises

Eastern and Western Caribbean sailings out of Port Everglades and Miami. First cruise or fifteenth, we make sure the cabin, the deck and the dining are right before you pay.

Group travel

Church trips, family reunions, destination weddings and team travel — one organizer, one itinerary, everyone on the same flights. Groups are where an agency earns its keep.
